Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking this on. We are in the final stage of onboarding a systems integrator (contract in parallel) and they have requested a current list of Redwood subprocessors that will touch telemetry and audit logs for our account. Specifically, they need:

- a CSV listing processor names, country of operation, and purpose (logs, metrics, support, billing)
- whether any of the processors operate outside the US/EU and the countries involved

They also need short-term, scoped read-only access to our diagnostic logs (30-45 minutes, for a triage session) and have asked whether we can issue a temporary MFA credential tied to the integrator engineer.

I attached a short questionnaire to capture the specifics the integrator needs (FinArc_Subprocessor_Questionnaire.xlsx). Can you confirm timeline for the CSV and whether Redwood supports temporary MFA scoped to a single session or if we need to provision an internal courier account?

Appreciate a quick turnaround — their go-live is planned for next week.

Jordan / Neha,

I exported the current processor roster and removed internal notes. See attachment: subprocessor_inventory_export_20260928.csv. Highlights / answers:

- Inventory CSV includes: processor_name, country, purpose_tag (logs/metrics/support/billing), last_contracted_date, crossborder_countries.
- For telemetry and diagnostic logs the primary subprocessors are: EdgeStream Ltd. (US/IE) — logs ingestion, ObservIQ (US) — metrics/alerts, and LogArchive Inc. (US) — cold storage.
- LogArchive has cold storage replication in Ireland for disaster recovery; transfers are covered by SCCs.
- We do not keep any PII inside diagnostic logs for FinArc (redaction pipeline applied); retention policy for logs is 90 days by default for hosted accounts.

Temporary access: we do not currently issue ad-hoc MFA tokens that can be scoped to a single external engineer. Options:

1) Create a time-limited service account with RBAC (read-only) and require MFA via SSO flow. Security will issue one-time access codes after SSO onboarding (approx 24–48 hours).
2) Share redacted log snapshots (preferred for very short triage) — can be scripted to produce a downloadable bundle.

If FinArc requires direct session access for the integrator this is doable but will need CISO approval for the scoped service account and an acceptance of our access audit trail requirements.

Next steps I recommend:
- provide the CSV to FinArc now (attached)
- ask if redacted snapshot suffices for the immediate triage (same-day)
- if they need direct session, we start a CISO approval request and prepare the scoped service account (48h).

— Kim Park
Manager, Trust & Safety, Redwood Inference

Hi Elena — thanks for the questionnaire and patience. Looping in the answers inline and next steps below.

On the roster: I attached a sanitized CSV (same file Kim exported) that lists each processor, country, and purpose. For your integrator: the processors that touch diagnostics/logs are EdgeStream Ltd. (US, Ireland), ObservIQ (US), and LogArchive Inc. (US with replication to IE). All cross-border replication is governed by SCCs and logged in our transfer matrix.

On temporary access: Redwood does not issue single-session MFA tokens. We can offer two practical paths depending on your risk tolerance:

- Option A (fastest, same-day): we produce a redacted snapshot bundle of the diagnostic logs the integrator needs and deliver via a secure Drive link. This is limited to the exact time ranges you specify and will be redacted for PII.
- Option B (sessioned access, 24–72h lead time): we provision a time-limited service account with read-only RBAC. This requires your integrator to complete our Security Onboarding Form and SSO setup; Security will then issue a one-time access code for the scoped window. Expect 24–48 hours for SSO + approval; 72 hours if CISO review is required.

DPA addendum: the draft we shared includes scopes for subprocessor notification (15 days notice) and SCCs for EU transfers. If you need a shorter notification window or contractual export restrictions, please flag items in the DocuSign link and we will iterate.

DocuSign for DPA addendum: https://www.docusign.com/rooms/finarc-dpa-addendum
Evidence folder (sanitized): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-finarc-evidence

Proposed short reply you can send to the integrator:

"We received Redwood's sanitized subprocessor roster and can accept a redacted diagnostic snapshot for the initial triage. If deeper session-level access is required we will complete Redwood's Security Onboarding Form and request a time-limited service account."

Let me know which option you prefer and the time range for the snapshot if Option A. If you want Option B, start the onboarding and share the integrator's email for SSO invite.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Privacy & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
